correctness.rationale: The dual has exactly 2n vertices, C(2n,2) edges, 6n induced-path triangles and n square tetrahedra. Every five-set contains a disconnected triple by a five-times-four edge-incidence contradiction. The 2n horizontal path columns have unique chord rows; for each square, 3 independent path columns have a 3x3 unit minor on both diagonals and one top edge. The combined 5n minor is unimodular. There are n independent tetrahedron-boundary 2-cycles, forcing exact boundary rank 5n and image d3=ker d2. Thus H1 dual is torsion-free of rank 2n^2-8n+1, all other reduced homology vanishes. Alexander duality yields all homology for the cut complex, while its full (2n-6) skeleton, Hurewicz and Whitehead yield the wedge type. Standalone finite checker n=5..9 verifies local determinants and ranks, but uniform proof does not depend on it.
